content: We obtain state of the art performance on both SNLI and MNLI with the RoBERTa model finetuned on our new data The RoBERTa paper BIBREF25 reports a score of $90.2$ for both MNLI-matched and -mismatched dev, while we obtain $91.0$ and $90.7$. The state of the art on SNLI is currently held by MT-DNN BIBREF31, which reports $91.6$ compared to our $92.9$.
